'''Coris''' was an [[Sith acolyte/Legends|acolyte]] in the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Korriban Sith Academy]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He ventured into the [[Tomb of Naga Sadow]] along with acolytes [[Jonos]] and [[Kolbrun]]. Though his fellow acolytes made it out alive, Coris [[Death/Legends|perished]] there.<ref name="TOR" />
